description: This file defines an abstract class MaterialsProvider in the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides an interface and some common functionality for handling cryptographic materials used in encryption/decryption processes.

classes.name: MaterialsProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing cryptographic material management, including key size support verification, encryption and decryption of content encryption keys (CEK), and IV generation.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size (in bits) is supported for AES encryption.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize the provider using data from a MetadataEnvelope.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the material description used for verification.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the name of the wrapping algorithm.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to encrypt a content encryption key (CEK).

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt an encrypted CEK.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a random content encryption key of specified size.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) suitable for a specified cipher.
